_note_index_based: Enums listed in _index_based declare no separate value in the Dart snapshot; their ordinal is the wire value. Field-confirmed for the dock capabilities (dock.cap.pw = 1 = supported, pd = 2 = unheatedAir).
_note_kotlin: The Kotlin @SerialName enums are merged in alongside the Dart ones. They were missing at first, and three value sets in this library (HazardType, RoomType, ScheduleFrequency) have no Dart counterpart at all -- their only vendor source is this half of the extract.
_note_serializers: 223 Kotlin @Serializable classes with their wire keys, and 89 SDK model field lists. Added after a coverage measurement showed 62% and 60% respectively -- numbers nobody had, because the gap report only ever looked at enums. Most of the remainder is message centre, surveys and entitlements, which are app account features rather than robot protocol; the point of carrying the data is that the distinction is now made in writing instead of assumed.
_purpose: Machine-checkable vendor reference. Value sets, gates and wire values are asserted against this, not recalled.
_source: iRobot app 3.0.0, decoded Dart snapshot (blutter) plus Kotlin @SerialName extraction
